GenBy.name: GenBy
GenBy.statement:
def GenBy (R : ℕ) (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] : Prop :=
  ∃ π : (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] X, Function.Surjective π

jZero.name: jZero
jZero.statement: abbrev jZero (l R : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.log l R + 3

IsLevel.name: IsLevel
IsLevel.statement: def IsLevel (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ) : Prop := vl l (u - 1) = c ∧ 1 ≤ c ∧ (l = 2 → 2 ≤ c)

cokLen.name: cokLen
cokLen.statement: def cokLen (f : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) : ℕ∞ := Module.length ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ LinearMap.range f)

InPow.name: InPow
InPow.statement: def InPow (k : ℕ) (f : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) : Prop := ∀ x : X, ∃ y : X, f x = (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ k • y

Unip.name: Unip
Unip.statement: def Unip (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) : Prop := ∃ N : ℕ, InPow 1 ((γ - 1) ^ N)

twLen.name: twLen
twLen.statement: def twLen (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (u : ℤ_[l]) (e m : ℕ) : ℕ∞ := cokLen ((u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ m - 1)

range.name: cokLen_le_of_range_le
range.statement:
theorem cokLen_le_of_range_le {f g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X} (h : LinearMap.range g ≤ LinearMap.range f) :
    cokLen f ≤ cokLen g

lenComp.name: Base.lenComp
lenComp.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Base.lenComp :
    ∀ (R N : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (a b : Module.End R N),
      Module.length R (LinearMap.ker (a * b)) ≤ Module.length R (LinearMap.ker a) + Module.length R (LinearMap.ker b) ∧
      Module.length R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range (a * b)) ≤ Module.length R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range a) + Module.length R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range b)

smith.name: length_cokernel_eq_addVal_det
smith.statement:
theorem length_cokernel_eq_addVal_det (Φ : Matrix n n O) :
    Module.length O (H2 Φ) = IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal O Φ.det

lift.name: lift
lift.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.lift :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X →
      ∃ S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l], ∀ c : ℤ_[l], cokLen (c • g - 1) ≤ vl l (c • S - 1).det

lte.name: abelian₂.lte
lte.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.abelian₂.lte :
    ∀ (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CharZero O] (l : ℕ), l.Prime → (l : O) ∈ maximalIdeal O → ∀ u : oneUnits O,
      addVal O (l : O) < ((l - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * addVal O (pt u : O) → (∀ n : ℤ, addVal O (pt (u ^ n) : O) = addVal O (pt u : O) + addVal O (n : O))

lteNorm.name: lteNorm
lteNorm.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.lteNorm :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ u - 1 ∧
      ∀ j a b : ℕ, ‖(u ^ l ^ j) ^ a - (u ^ l ^ j) ^ b‖ = ((l : ℝ) ^ (j + c))⁻¹ * ‖(a : ℤ_[l]) - b‖

units.name: padic_units_distance_le_max
units.statement:
private theorem padic_units_distance_le_max (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (a b : ℤ_[l]) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (z : PadicAlgCl l) :
    ‖a - b‖ ≤ max ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (a : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖
      ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (b : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖

helly.name: helly
helly.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.helly :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (x : ℕ → ℤ_[l]) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ a b, ‖x a - x b‖ ≤ max (r a) (r b)) →
      ∃ s : ℤ_[l], ∀ a, ‖s - x a‖ ≤ r a

ball.name: ball
ball.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.ball :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ∀ (j : ℕ) (z : PadicAlgCl l), ∃ s : ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ,
      ((l : ℝ) ^ (j + c))⁻¹ * ‖s - e‖ ≤ ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (((u ^ l ^ j) ^ e : ℤ_[l]) : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖

detFactor.name: detFactor
detFactor.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.detFactor :
    ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ) (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K),
      ∃ z : Fin n → K, ∀ c : K, (c • S - 1).det = ∏ i, (c * z i - 1)

normVal.name: normVal
normVal.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.normVal :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (R c : ℕ) (d : ℤ_[l]) (x : Fin R → ℤ_[l]),
      ∏ i, (((l : ℝ) ^ c)⁻¹ * ‖x i‖) ≤ ‖d‖ → vl l d ≤ ∑ i, ((c : ℕ∞) + vl l (x i))

detBound.name: detBound
detBound.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.detBound :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ∀ (j R : ℕ) (S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l]),
      ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, vl l ((u ^ l ^ j) ^ e • S - 1).det ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e))

level.name: exists_centres_level
level.statement:
theorem exists_centres_level {R c : ℕ} (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hu : IsLevel l u c) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, twLen γ u e j ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e))

cokL.name: cokL
cokL.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.cokL :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ), GenBy l R X → cokLen ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) ≤ R

nilLen.name: nilLen
nilLen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.nilLen :
    ∀ (A M : Type) [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (f : Module.End A M) (n : ℕ), IsNilpotent f →
      Module.length A M ≤ n → f ^ n = 0

unipPow.name: unipPow
unipPow.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.unipPow :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → Unip g → InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ R)

frob.name: frob
frob.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.frob :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (k : ℕ),
      InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ l ^ k) ↔ InPow 1 (g ^ l ^ k - 1)

powIn.name: powIn
powIn.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.powIn :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X),
      (∀ k n : ℕ, InPow k (w - 1) → InPow k (w ^ n - 1)) ∧ (InPow 1 (w - 1) → InPow 2 (w ^ l - 1))

phi.name: phi
phi.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.phi :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] [Module.Finite ℤ_[l] X] (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), InPow 2 (w - 1) →
      LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) ≤ LinearMap.range (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i)

step.name: step
step.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.step :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → InPow 2 (w - 1) →
      cokLen (w ^ l - 1) ≤ cokLen (w - 1) + R

mono.name: mono
mono.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.mono :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (a b : ℕ), a ∣ b →
      cokLen (g ^ a - 1) ≤ cokLen (g ^ b - 1)

twist.name: twist
twist.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.twist :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (a : ℤ_[l]), (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ a - 1 →
      Unip g → Unip (a • g)

growth.name: growth
growth.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.growth :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → Unip g → ∀ m : ℕ,
      cokLen (g ^ l ^ m - 1) ≤ cokLen (g ^ l ^ jZero l R - 1) + ((R * (m - jZero l R) : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

twgrowth.name: twLen_le_growth
twgrowth.statement:
theorem twLen_le_growth {R c : ℕ} {γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X} {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hγ : Unip γ) (hu : IsLevel l u c)
    (e m : ℕ) : twLen γ u e m ≤ twLen γ u e (jZero l R) + ((R * (m - jZero l R) : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

centres.name: exists_centres
centres.statement:
theorem exists_centres {R c : ℕ} {γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X} {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hγ : Unip γ) (hu : IsLevel l u c) :
    ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e m : ℕ,
      twLen γ u e m ≤ ∑ i, (((max m (jZero l R) + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e))

centresnorm.name: exists_centres_norm
centresnorm.statement:
theorem exists_centres_norm {R c : ℕ} {γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X} {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hγ : Unip γ)
    (hu : IsLevel l u c) : ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e m B : ℕ, (∀ i, (l : ℝ) ^ (-(B : ℤ)) ≤ ‖s i - e‖) →
      twLen γ u e m ≤ ((R * (max m (jZero l R) + c + B) : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

near1.name: Win.near1
near1.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Win.near1 :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (K : Type) [NormedField K] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (s : K) (Z a b : ℕ),
      1 ≤ a → a ≤ Z → 1 ≤ b → b ≤ Z → ‖s - (a : K)‖ < (l : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log l Z : ℤ)) →
        ‖s - (b : K)‖ < (l : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log l Z : ℤ)) → a = b

exc.name: Win.exc
exc.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Win.exc :
    ∀ (l R : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀], ABound l R L₀ →
      ∃ c : ℕ, (∃ ζ : L₀, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) ∧ ∀ Z : ℕ, ∃ Exc : Finset ℕ, FirstBound l R c L₀ Z Exc

qzInj.name: qzInj
qzInj.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.qzInj :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], Module.Injective ℤ_[l] (QZ l)

dualDiv.name: dualDiv
dualDiv.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualDiv :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D] (x : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l), (∀ φ : D, (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0 → x φ = 0) →
      ∃ y : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, x = (l : ℤ_[l]) • y

torsFin.name: torsFin
torsFin.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.torsFin :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D], Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) →
      {φ : D | (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0}.Finite

dualUnip.name: dualUnip
dualUnip.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualUnip :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] D) (t : Module.End ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)),
      Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) → (∀ x φ, t x φ = x (g φ)) → (∀ φ : D, ∃ k : ℕ, ((g - 1) ^ k) φ = 0) → Unip t

XDual.name: XDual
XDual.statement:
def XDual (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] : Submodule R (U → M) where
  carrier := {φ | IsLocallyConstant φ ∧ (∀ a b, φ (a * b) = φ a + φ b) ∧
    (∀ (A : ValuationSubring Ω) (u : U), u.1 ∈ Ine (F := F) A → φ u = 0) ∧
    ∀ A : ValuationSubring Ω, A.valuation (N : Ω) < 1 → ∀ u : U, u.1 ∈ Dec (F := F) A → φ u = 0}
  zero_mem' := ⟨IsLocallyConstant.const _, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  add_mem' {a b} ha hb := ⟨ha.1.add hb.1, fun x y => by simp only [Pi.add_apply, ha.2.1, hb.2.1]; abel,
    fun A u h => by simp [ha.2.2.1 A u h, hb.2.2.1 A u h],
    fun A hA u h => by simp [ha.2.2.2 A hA u h, hb.2.2.2 A hA u h]⟩
  smul_mem' c a ha := ⟨ha.1.comp (c • ·), fun x y => by simp [ha.2.1], fun A u h => by simp [ha.2.2.1 A u h],
    fun A hA u h => by simp [ha.2.2.2 A hA u h]⟩

IsTower.name: Tower.IsTower
IsTower.statement:
structure IsTower (R : ℕ) : Prop where
  complex : IsTotallyComplex L
  mu : HasMuQ l L
  pos : 1 ≤ R
  gen : GenLE ℤ_[l] (XP l L) R

IsLayer.name: IsLayer
IsLayer.statement:
def IsLayer (l j : ℕ) (L L' : Type) [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra L L'] : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℕ, IsCyclotomicExtension {l ^ k} L L') ∧ Module.finrank L L' = l ^ j

shaInv.name: shaInv
shaInv.statement:
def shaInv (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (e : ℤ) : ℕ∞ :=
  Module.length ℤ_[l] (ShaAbs (qzG F (AlgebraicClosure F) l e) (Above F l))

VLen.name: VLen
VLen.statement: def VLen (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : ℕ∞ := Module.length ℤ_[l] (H2 (zlTw D (e + 1)))

ABound.name: Win.ABound
ABound.statement:
def ABound (l R : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] : Prop :=
  (∃ (K : Type) (_ : NormedField K) (_ : NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] K) (_ : IsUltrametricDist K) (c R' : ℕ) (s : Fin R' → K),
    R' ≤ R ∧ (∃ ζ : L₀, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) ∧
    ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → ∀ (m : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L₀ L₁], IsLayer l m L₀ L₁ →
      ∀ B : ℕ, (∀ i, (l : ℝ) ^ (-(B : ℤ)) ≤ ‖s i - (e : K)‖) →
        shaInv L₁ l e ≤ ((R' * (max m (jZero l R) + c + B) : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) ∧
  SecondBound l R L₀

SecondBound.name: Win.SecondBound
SecondBound.statement:
def SecondBound (l R : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] : Prop :=
  ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → ∀ (m : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L₀ L₁], IsLayer l m L₀ L₁ →
    ∀ (L₂ : Type) [Field L₂] [NumberField L₂] [Algebra L₀ L₂], IsLayer l (jZero l R) L₀ L₂ →
      ∀ (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [Algebra L₂ Ω] [IsAlgClosure L₂ Ω] (D : LData L₂ Ω l),
        shaInv L₁ l e ≤ VLen D e + ((R * (m - jZero l R) : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

FirstBound.name: Win.FirstBound
FirstBound.statement:
def FirstBound (l R c : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] (Z : ℕ) (Exc : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Exc.card ≤ R ∧ ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → e ≤ Z → e ∉ Exc →
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L₀ L₁], IsLayer l m L₀ L₁ →
      shaInv L₁ l e ≤ ((R * (max m (jZero l R) + c + Nat.log l Z) : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

dinfNil.name: Kum.dinfNil
dinfNil.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.dinfNil :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) [U.Normal], IsClosed (U : Set (G F Ω)) → ∀ φ ∈ Dinf l N U, (∃ n, ∀ g ∈ levU l U n, funRep ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (cycU l U) g φ = φ) ∧
    ∀ γ ∈ levU l U 1, ∃ k : ℕ, (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ k • φ = 0 ∧ ((funRep ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (cycU l U) γ - 1) ^ k) φ = 0

xUnip.name: xUnip
xUnip.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.xUnip :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ)
      (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal], IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (Xinf l N U) →
      ∀ γ ∈ levU l U 1, Unip (xRep l N U γ)

step0.name: Tower.step0
step0.statement:
theorem step0 (hμ : HasMuQ l L₀) {γ : G L₀ Ω} (hγ : IsGen l ⊤ γ) {e : ℤ} (he : e ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁]
    [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L₀ L₁] (hL : IsLayer l m L₀ L₁) :
    shaInv L₁ l e = cokerLen (xTw l l (⊤ : Subgroup (G L₀ Ω)) e γ ^ l ^ m - 1)

isTowerIff.name: Tower.isTower_iff
isTowerIff.statement: theorem isTower_iff (R : ℕ) : IsTower l L₀ R ↔ HasMuQ l L₀ ∧ 1 ≤ R ∧ rankN l L₀ l ≤ R

Descends.name: Descends

descends.name: descends
descends.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.descends :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] [NumberField L₀], HasMuQ l L₀ →
      ∀ γ : G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀), IsGen l ⊤ γ → Descends l L₀ γ

cycRange.name: Tower.cycRange
cycRange.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.cycRange :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], HasMuQ l L → (cycZ L Ω l).range = KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L)

genLevel.name: genLevel
genLevel.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.genLevel :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] [NumberField L₀], HasMuQ l L₀ →
      ∃ γ : G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀), IsGen l ⊤ γ ∧ IsLevel l (cycZ L₀ _ l γ : ℤ_[l]) (cZero l L₀) ∧
        ∃ ζ : L₀, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ cZero l L₀)

shaLeV.name: shaLeV
shaLeV.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.shaLeV :
    GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality → LocalFinitenessK → LocalTateDualityK →
      ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime],
        PTCase F l → ∀ (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ), shaLen D e ≤ VLen D e

aDesc.name: aBound_of_descends

aTower.name: aBound_of_isTower
aTower.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.aBound_of_isTower (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK)
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] [NumberField L₀] (R : ℕ) (ht : UpperTheory.V.Tower.IsTower l L₀ R) :
    UpperTheory.V.Win.ABound l R L₀

FW.name: Published.FerreroWashington
FW.statement:
def FerreroWashington : Prop :=
  ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsAbelianGalois ℚ K],
    (∃ ζ : K, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (if l = 2 then 4 else l)) →
    ∃ r : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (K' : Type) [Field K'] [NumberField K'] [Algebra K K'] [IsCyclotomicExtension {l ^ n} K K'],
      Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 K') ⧸ (powMonoidHom l : ClassGroup (𝓞 K') →* ClassGroup (𝓞 K')).range) ≤ l ^ r

towerFixed.name: Two.towerFixed
towerFixed.statement:
theorem towerFixed (hFW : Published.FerreroWashington) (l : ℕ) [hl : Fact l.Prime] (h2 : l ≠ 2) (A : AbF) (hA : A.HasMu l) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ (L : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L], IsAbField A L →
      Tower.GenLE ℤ_[l] (Tower.XX l L) R ∧ Tower.IsTower l L R

LemmaK.name: LemmaK
LemmaK.statement:
def LemmaK (CK : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω]
    (D : LData L Ω l), IsTotallyComplex L → HasMuQ l L → ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e →
      Finite (H2 (zlTw D ((e : ℤ) + 1))) ∧
        Real.log (Nat.card (H2 (zlTw D ((e : ℤ) + 1)))) ≤ kBound CK e (Module.finrank ℚ L) (discr L).natAbs

window.name: Win.window
window.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Win.window :
    ∀ (R : ℕ) (eta Ct X : ℝ) (Exc : Finset ℕ), 0 < eta → eta ≤ Ct → 1 < X → Exc.card ≤ R →
      ∃ Y : ℝ, InRange (2 ^ (R + 2) * (Ct / eta) ^ R) X Y ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, Y ≤ x → x ≤ Y ^ (2 : ℝ) → Good eta Ct Exc x

thmBab.name: Win.thmBab_of
thmBab.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Win.thmBab_of :
    (∃ CK : ℝ, LemmaK CK) → FixedIn → TwoIn → ∃ K : BConst, ∀ Ct : ℝ, 1 ≤ Ct → ThmBab K Ct

thmBabK.name: Win.thmBab_of_lemmaK
thmBabK.statement:
theorem thmBab_of_lemmaK (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK)
    (hFW : Published.FerreroWashington) (hK : ∃ CK : ℝ, LemmaK CK) : ∃ K : BConst, ∀ Ct : ℝ, 1 ≤ Ct → ThmBab K Ct

vl.name: vl
vl.statement: abbrev vl (x : ℤ_[l]) : ℕ∞ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] x

normDvd.name: norm_le_of_dvd'
normDvd.statement: private theorem norm_le_of_dvd' {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {x y : ℤ_[l]} (h : x ∣ y) : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖

normAddVal.name: norm_eq_of_addVal

dvdNorm.name: dvd_of_norm_le'
dvdNorm.statement: private theorem dvd_of_norm_le' {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {d y : ℤ_[l]} (h : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖d‖) : d ∣ y

vlProd.name: vl_prod
vlProd.statement:
private theorem vl_prod {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℤ_[l]) :
    vl l (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, vl l (f i)

nilSucc.name: nilLen_range_succ
nilSucc.statement:
private theorem nilLen_range_succ {A M : Type} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (f : Module.End A M) (k : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + 1)) = (LinearMap.range (f ^ k)).map f

nilLt.name: nilLen_lt
nilLt.statement:
private theorem nilLen_lt {A M : Type} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (f : Module.End A M) (hf : IsNilpotent f) (k : ℕ) (hk : f ^ k ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + 1)) < LinearMap.range (f ^ k)

vlNorm.name: vl_le_of_norm
vlNorm.statement: theorem vl_le_of_norm {x : ℤ_[l]} {B : ℕ} (h : (l : ℝ) ^ (-(B : ℤ)) ≤ ‖x‖) : vl l x ≤ B

memLev.name: mem_levU_one
memLev.statement:
theorem mem_levU_one {k Ω : Type} [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] {γ : G k Ω}
    (h : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) - 1) : γ ∈ levU l (⊤ : Subgroup (G k Ω)) 1

eqTwLen.name: Descends.eq_twLen

qzSep.name: Tower.qzSep
qzSep.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.qzSep :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (m : M), m ≠ 0 → ∃ f : M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, f m ≠ 0

qzAnn.name: exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero
qzAnn.statement:
private theorem exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M]
    (m : M) (hm : m ≠ 0) : ∃ x : QZ l, x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ_[l], a • m = 0 → a • x = 0

exactDual.name: exact_dual
exactDual.statement:
private theorem exact_dual (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℤ_[l] N]
    (p : Submodule ℤ_[l] N) :
    Function.Exact (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.mkQ) (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.subtype)

simpleDual.name: simple_dual
simpleDual.statement:
private theorem simple_dual (l : ℕ) [hl : Fact l.Prime]
    (N : Type) [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℤ_[l] N] [hN : IsSimpleModule ℤ_[l] N] :
    IsSimpleModule ℤ_[l] (N →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)

leDual.name: le_dual
leDual.statement:
private theorem le_dual (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : Type) [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℤ_[l] N] :
    Module.length ℤ_[l] N ≤ Module.length ℤ_[l] (N →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)

lenDual.name: Tower.lenDual
lenDual.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.lenDual :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M], Module.length ℤ_[l] (M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) = Module.length ℤ_[l] M

dualKer.name: Tower.dualKer
dualKer.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.dualKer :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (M' : Type) [AddCommGroup M'] [Module ℤ_[l] M'] (T : M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] M'),
        LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) T) = LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (LinearMap.ker T).subtype) ∧
        ∀ p : Submodule ℤ_[l] M, Function.Surjective (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.subtype)

cokerDual.name: Tower.cokerDual
cokerDual.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.cokerDual :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] M) (t : Module.End ℤ_[l] (M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)), (∀ x φ, t x φ = x (g φ)) →
        cokerLen t = Module.length ℤ_[l] (LinearMap.ker g)

pgIndex.name: pg_index
pgIndex.statement:
private theorem pg_index {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {a : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l a).index = l ^ (a - 1) * (l - 1)

pgExists.name: pg_exists
pgExists.statement:
private theorem pg_exists {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {c : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ c) :
    ∃ v ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c, v ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + 1)

pgEmult.name: pg_emult

princGen.name: Tower.princGen
princGen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.princGen :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : ℕ), qExp l ≤ c →
        (∀ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c, (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c ≤ (Subgroup.zpowers u).topologicalClosure ↔ u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + 1))) ∧
        (∀ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c, u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + 1) → PropA.IsLevel l (u : ℤ_[l]) c ∧
          ∀ m : ℕ, u ^ l ^ m ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + m) ∧ u ^ l ^ m ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + m + 1)) ∧
        ∀ m : ℕ, (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + m)).relIndex (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c) = l ^ m

princClosed.name: princ_le_of_isClosed

lteOdd.name: emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_odd
lteOdd.statement:
theorem emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_odd (hl : l ≠ 2) {u : ℤ_[l]} (hu : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ u - 1) (n : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u ^ n - 1) =
      emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u - 1) + emultiplicity l n

lteSq.name: emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_sq
lteSq.statement:
theorem emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_sq {u : ℤ_[l]} (hu : (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ 2 ∣ u - 1) (n : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u ^ n - 1) =
      emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u - 1) + emultiplicity l n

cZero.name: Tower.cZero
cZero.statement: def cZero : ℕ := sSup {c : ℕ | ∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)}

layU.name: Tower.layU
layU.statement: abbrev layU (m : ℕ) : Subgroup (G L Ω) := Un L Ω l (cZero l L + m)

muQ.name: Tower.muQ
muQ.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.muQ :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], (∀ c : ℕ, (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) ↔ c ≤ cZero l L) ∧ (∀ c : ℕ, Un L Ω l c = ⊤ ↔ c ≤ cZero l L) ∧
        (HasMuQ l L ↔ qExp l ≤ cZero l L) ∧ (HasMuQ l L → IsTotallyComplex L ∧ Procyc L Ω l) ∧ (Procyc L Ω l ↔ l ≠ 2 ∨ HasMuQ l L)

galOfCyc.name: Kum.galOfCyc
galOfCyc.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.galOfCyc :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (n : ℕ) (E K : Type) [Field E] [Field K] [Algebra E K] [Algebra E Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsScalarTower E K Ω] [IsCyclotomicExtension {l ^ n} E K], galOf F K Ω = levU l (galOf F E Ω) n

galEmbTop.name: Base.galEmbTop
galEmbTop.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Base.galEmbTop :
    ∀ (k E Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field E] [NumberField E] [Field Ω] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
      [IsScalarTower k E Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] [IsAlgClosure E Ω],
      Topology.IsEmbedding (galEmb k E Ω) ∧ IsOpen (galOf k E Ω : Set (G k Ω)) ∧ (galOf k E Ω).index = Module.finrank k E

luKey.name: lu_key
luKey.statement:
private theorem lu_key (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ)
    [Fact l.Prime] (hmu : HasMuQ l L) (n : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L L₁] [Algebra L₁ Ω]
    [IsScalarTower L L₁ Ω] [IsCyclotomicExtension {l ^ n} L L₁] :
    galOf L L₁ Ω = layU l L Ω (n - cZero l L) ∧ Module.finrank L L₁ = l ^ (n - cZero l L)

layerUniq.name: Tower.layerUniq
layerUniq.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.layerUniq :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], HasMuQ l L → (∀ m, IsLayer l m L (layF l L Ω m)) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L L₁] [Algebra L₁ Ω] [IsScalarTower L L₁ Ω], IsLayer l m L L₁ → galOf L L₁ Ω = layU l L Ω m) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L L₁], IsCyclotomicExtension {l ^ n} L L₁ → IsLayer l (n - cZero l L) L L₁

layerGen.name: Tower.layerGen
layerGen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.layerGen :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], HasMuQ l L → (∀ m, (layU l L Ω m).index = l ^ m) ∧
        ∀ γ : G L Ω, IsGen l ⊤ γ → PropA.IsLevel l (cycZ L Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]ˣ) (cZero l L) ∧ γ ∈ levU l ⊤ 1 ∧ ∀ m, IsGen l (layU l L Ω m) (γ ^ l ^ m)

IsGen.name: Tower.IsGen
IsGen.statement:
def IsGen (γ : G k Ω) : Prop :=
  γ ∈ U ∧ U.map (cycZ k Ω l) ≤ (Subgroup.zpowers (cycZ k Ω l γ)).topologicalClosure

dTw.name: Tower.dTw
dTw.statement: def dTw (e : ℤ) : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Dinf l N U) := twist (dRep l N U) (cycZ k Ω l ^ (-e))

xTw.name: Tower.xTw
xTw.statement: def xTw (e : ℤ) : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Xinf l N U) := twist (xRep l N U) (cycZ k Ω l ^ e)

xTwApply.name: Tower.xTw_apply_apply
xTwApply.statement:
theorem xTw_apply_apply (e : ℤ) (g : G k Ω) (x : Xinf l N U) (φ : Dinf l N U) :
    xTw l N U e g x φ = x (dTw l N U e g⁻¹ φ)

ShaD.name: Tower.ShaD
ShaD.statement:
abbrev ShaD (e : ℤ) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (Dinf l N U) :=
  Representation.invariants ((dTw l N U e).comp V.subtype : Representation ℤ_[l] V (Dinf l N U))

desc.name: Tower.desc
desc.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.desc :
    ∀ (k L Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsScalarTower k L Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : LData L Ω l) (e : ℤ) (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal], e ≠ 0 → Procyc L Ω l → cycU l U = cycU l (galOf k L Ω) →
        ∃ Φ : Sha D e ≃ₗ[ℤ_[l]] ShaD l l U (galOf k L Ω) e, IsDesc L D e U Φ.toLinearMap

shaLenInv.name: shaLen_eq_shaInv
shaLenInv.statement: theorem shaLen_eq_shaInv (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : shaLen D e = shaInv F l e

shaDGen.name: Tower.shaDGen
shaDGen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.shaDGen :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U V : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal] (e : ℤ) (γ : G k Ω), IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → V ≤ U → IsGen l V γ →
        ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ - 1) ∧ ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ⁻¹ - 1)
